output_guide_capture.method: Actual Excel desktop window screenshots with computer-use sky API. PDF uses clipped viewports of the unchanged screenshots. No fabricated UI.
output_guide_capture.operations: Navigated actual worksheets; displayed mesh preview on dedicated copy; closed without saving. No analysis, material, convergence or source changes.
output_guide_capture.plots: Existing road stages 1/4/6/11 and 12 wall DAVIS SRM trials. Rebuild from published compressed records by running rebuild_output_guide.py from repository root.

historical_slope_srm.scope: Historical completed INCO24 runs, not new UI04 runs. All values from public archives.

wall_section_moments.scope: Existing construction-complete stage3 Fs1, DAVIS, unchanged archived workbooks. No new Excel solve.
wall_section_moments.stress_convention: Saved compression-positive tensor C; tensile-positive T=-C. n=+Y for stem, n=+X for base. Mz=integral (r-rc) cross (T n) ds, positive counter-clockwise.
wall_section_moments.reconstruction: Bilinear in natural coordinates through four saved GP stress tensors; exact Q8 edge intersections, inverse mapping and Gauss line quadrature. Mean of fixed-station +/-1e-7m limits; gap retained.

self_checks.basis: Known membrane plus linear bending normal stress and constant shear; 1/3 through-thickness patches; both cut normals

release.scope: six UI/observer/display modules only; solver/material equations and convergence settings unchanged

hand_calculation.assumptions: uniform horizontal elastic layer; laterally constrained; not applicable directly to slope

numerical.validation_scope: Programmatic Excel Validation.Value/STOP metadata and VBE compilation, not novice physical keyboard-dialog user testing. Observer zero threshold tests are synthetic, not a full plastic hold/SRM regression. No convergence/material conditions loosened.
